rv.q: We are very fortunate to have this fine production of Toossi’s second play currently on stage in the Washington DC area at such pivotal moment when we need to reflect more deeply on our universal humanity.
The avenue through which it communicates its vital message is unique and necessary.
The deft opening scene is both exuberantly raucous and telling, capturing the personalities and restless energies of a circle of BFFs at a watershed historical moment.

Studio’s production, directed by Sivan Battat , crafts a refreshing, slice-of-life story of friendship where the women at the show’s center crack frequent jokes about periods, pregnancy, and their own bodies.
